projects.name: Plasma
projects.longDescription: Plasma is a cutting-edge energy management system that helps businesses optimize their power consumption and reduce costs. Through intelligent monitoring, predictive analytics, and automated controls, it makes sustainable energy management effortless.
projects.additionalDescription: Energy waste is often invisible, making it easy to ignore. Plasma was designed to make energy consumption tangible and actionable. Real-time visualizations show exactly where energy goes, while AI-powered recommendations identify savings opportunities that would otherwise go unnoticed.
highlights: Built real-time monitoring with IoT sensor integration
Implemented ML-based consumption prediction with 95% accuracy
Created automated demand response for peak load management
Designed ROI calculators for sustainability investments

projects.name: Relative
projects.longDescription: Relative helps you discover and visualize your family history. Build comprehensive family trees, share stories across generations, and connect with relatives you never knew existed. Your heritage, beautifully mapped.
projects.additionalDescription: Family history is more than names and dates — it is stories, traditions, and connections that span generations. Relative was designed to capture all of that richness. Every feature encourages users to go beyond the basic tree and bring their ancestors to life.
highlights: Created an interactive tree visualization supporting thousands of relatives
Built collaborative editing so families can build trees together
Implemented smart matching to suggest potential family connections
Designed a timeline view showing family events across generations
